claims: Texas Christian University (TCU) is a private university in Fort Worth, Texas.
TCU has NCAA Division I athletics.
TCU's athletics are nicknamed the Horned Frogs.
As of March 2026, the TCU men's basketball team is competing in the NCAA Tournament as a #9 seed.
The TCU men's basketball team had a first-round victory against Ohio State.
TCU's athletics compete in the Big 12 Conference.
TCU is affiliated with the Disciples of Christ tradition.
